notes.title: OH Playtesting build version 2021.4.pt1
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

New build is available for playtesting! Here is a short changelog for this version:
[list]
[*] Build includes second level from Sand World location with brand new boss.
[*] New sound effects are added for various game events, like death or damage hit.
[*] Hit freeze is added: When player gets damage game freezes for several frames.
[*] "Freezing coolness" level modifier is redesigned to decrease firerate instead of completely locking primary weapon.
[*] "Chasing crystals" level modifier is completely reworked,
[*] "Get it back!" level modifier reflects player bullets, but those doesn't damage player anymore.
[*] Tons of small bugfixes and improvements!
[/list]

Hope you will enjoy new version and looking forward to getting your feedback!
